coordinate_frames.world_map_alignment_basis: Gazebo world origin (0,0,0) is at the geometric center of the arena (location of the central cylinder). turtlebot3_world.yaml defines resolution 0.050000 m/px, origin [-10.0, -10.0, 0.0] on a 384x384 image, placing pixel (200, 200) at coordinate (0,0) in map frame, identically aligned with Gazebo world origin. The robot spawn pose in Gazebo is [-2.0, -0.5, 0.0] and initial AMCL pose is published at [-2.0, -0.5, 0.0, map]. Therefore, p_map == p_world and theta_map == theta_world.
